title: A producer works across the arrangement, the instrument and the mixer

steps.caption: A new project opens on a full-page arrangement, with the dock
Open the clip — the sequence editor fills the window
Turn on a step that was off
Close it — the arrangement is underneath, unchanged
Press 2 — the instrument fills the page, tracks down the left
Press 3 — pull the track's fader down in the mixer
Back to the arrangement from the dock
Reload the mixer — it reopens there, fader where you left it
